name: LanGuard-Backend
description: LanGuard Backend is the core API, database engine, and integration hub for LanGuard. NOTE: This is the backend component of the LanGuard stack. It should be deployed alongside LanGuard (frontend) and LanGuard-Scanner . Runs on the host network with privileged access to perform network-level operations. Credits & Support: - Created by Yossi Hillali ( GitHub ). Support the developer on PayPal . - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

paths.name: AppData Database
paths.description: Storage path for SQLite database (db.sqlite3) and application logs. Must be shared with LanGuard-Scanner.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Long random secret key used for session signing and cryptographic tokens (generate e.g. with 'openssl rand -base64 48'). Must be identical to the one in LanGuard-Scanner.

variables.name: Allowed Hosts
variables.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames or IP addresses allowed to reach the API (must include 127.0.0.1 for health checks).

variables.name: Backend Listen Port
variables.description: Port on which the backend Granian WSGI web server listens (default 8000).
